name: Healthcare in the Elysian Concord
summary: System structure and workforce, the named clinician, home-first care, prevention and its discontinued programmes, emergency response, geriatrics, mental health, substance policy, genetics, end of life, and epidemic capability.

units.time: civil minutes or Elysian years as stated

facilities.name: Commune health post
facilities.summary: First contact, prevention, home-care coordination, and the named clinician.

facilities.name: Regional specialist centre
facilities.summary: Complex surgery, transplantation, rare disease, major trauma.

facilities.name: Concord facility
facilities.summary: Biosecurity containment, orphan conditions, reference laboratories.

namedClinician.name: The named clinician
namedClinician.summary: Every resident has a named generalist accountable for their care across life, often following the same patient fifty years and three or four generations of one household.

homeFirstCare.auditNote: District accounts showing home care cheaper than hospital care at equivalent acuity are audited on suspicion.
homeFirstCare.acknowledgedRisk: A system that leans on households leans hardest on the people in them, and unpaid care is unevenly distributed.

prevention.reviewQuestion: Does the programme improve outcomes, not does it find disease.
prevention.discontinuationNote: Discontinued for causing more harm through over-diagnosis, anxiety, and unnecessary intervention than they prevented. Politically difficult each time, because a screening programme has a visible constituency who believe it saved them and an invisible one it harmed.

cognitiveDecline.name: Late-life cognitive decline
cognitiveDecline.summary: The single largest cause of disability in the Concord and its most conspicuous unsolved medical problem; a category of neurological attrition shorter-lived populations largely die before reaching.

mentalHealth.canonNote: Access is excellent and stigma low, and the rate has not moved in sixty years despite substantial investment. The services describe the plateau in their own reviews as unexplained.

substanceUse.canonNote: Regulated supply has near-eliminated the harms of dependence without reducing dependence, and canon states that rather than claiming otherwise.

genetics.tractabilityReason: Helicin's redundant codon families make targeted correction more tractable than Earth genetics would allow.

germlineModification.exception: to prevent a specific severe disorder, under judicial licence
germlineModification.rationale: A modified descendant cannot agree to what was done to them.

reproductiveDecisions.canonNote: The Concord's demographic flatness is a consequence of freedom, not of policy, and the constitution keeps it that way deliberately.

safeguards: legal majority, decisional competence at every stage, and absence of coercion
a settled repeated request across a minimum of 90 days
a second independent clinical assessment and an independent non-clinical review
no eligibility on grounds of disability, age, dependence, or cost
frailty alone does not qualify; a specific condition causing suffering the person finds unbearable is required
any clinician may decline for any reason without stating one and without professional consequence
post-hoc review by a body independent of the treating service, published anonymised
assistedDying.objection: No safeguard can distinguish a free choice from one made by someone who has been made to feel like a burden, and in a society with 710 million very old people the pressure need never be spoken to be felt. Monitoring detects coercion only when it leaves evidence.
assistedDying.canonPosition: A live and unresolved moral disagreement in which the Concord has chosen a side. Canon does not present the choice as settled.

capabilities.name: Vaccine platform capacity
capabilities.summary: Full planetary course within 210 days of a sequence.

capabilities.name: Reserve isolation beds
capabilities.summary: Maintained empty against a novel pathogen.

capabilities.name: Antiviral and antimicrobial stockpile
capabilities.summary: Two Elysian years of projected need.

capabilities.name: Planetary exercise
capabilities.summary: Full unannounced exercise every four years within a stated quarter.

knownWeaknesses.name: The cost curve
knownWeaknesses.summary: An old population generates a spending trajectory rising faster than GCP for eighty years, with no proposed solution that survives contact with Charter right 9.

knownWeaknesses.name: Care workforce
knownWeaknesses.summary: 6.4% vacancies and higher in frailty-intensive roles; the largest single labour shortage in the Concord.

knownWeaknesses.name: Unpaid household care
knownWeaknesses.summary: The home-first model rests on household capacity, unevenly distributed and falling disproportionately on women and the least wealthy households. Partially compensated, not solved.

knownWeaknesses.name: Rural response times
knownWeaknesses.summary: A 74-minute median in Northreach against 6 in cities, narrowed only slightly in a century.

knownWeaknesses.name: Over-diagnosis
knownWeaknesses.summary: Three programmes discontinued, and the reviews consistently find the problem larger than the discontinuations address.

knownWeaknesses.name: Handover quality
knownWeaknesses.summary: Continuity is protocolised and still degrades at transfer; outcomes worsen measurably in the two years after a named clinician changes.

knownWeaknesses.name: Late-life cognitive decline
knownWeaknesses.summary: 21% of over-110s, no prevention and no reversal after two centuries, and the research that might help is foreclosed by a privacy prohibition its own practitioners support.

knownWeaknesses.name: The suicide plateau
knownWeaknesses.summary: Flat for sixty years despite investment; described by the services themselves as unexplained.

knownWeaknesses.name: Dependence unchanged
knownWeaknesses.summary: Regulated supply has near-eliminated the harms of dependence without reducing dependence.

knownWeaknesses.name: Assisted dying and coercion
knownWeaknesses.summary: Monitoring detects coercion only when it leaves evidence; the objection is unanswered and two repeal campaigns have failed narrowly.

knownWeaknesses.name: Pathogen preparedness is bounded by restraint
knownWeaknesses.summary: 210 days to a planetary vaccine course is fast and not instant, and the Concord has chosen not to study the threats it fears most.

knownWeaknesses.name: Germline licences drift
knownWeaknesses.summary: Fourteen licences in seventy years, each slightly widening what counts as a specific severe disorder.

knownWeaknesses.name: Reserve capacity is expensive and idle
knownWeaknesses.summary: 14 million empty beds and a two-year stockpile cost real money continuously to answer a risk that arrives rarely.
